reviews.title: Better than anything I've owned
reviews.body: I've bought cuffs from three other makers and these are in a different league. The suede lining is soft enough to wear for hours and the padding hasn't flattened at all after a few months of regular use. The stitching is dead straight the whole way around.
reviews.author: Marren H.

reviews.title: Worth every penny
reviews.body: The hardware feels genuinely solid, no rattle or flex when you pull against it. My partner and I have put these through a lot and they still look new. Shipping took about two weeks since they're made to order, which was communicated clearly up front.
reviews.author: J. Ashcombe

reviews.title: Beautiful, sized up
reviews.body: No complaints about the build at all, they're gorgeous. My only note is that the small ran a little snug on me and I'd have been happier in a medium. Measure your wrists properly before ordering and you'll be fine.
reviews.author: Devi R.

reviews.title: The leather smells incredible
reviews.body: A small thing, but opening the box was an experience. Real vegetable-tanned leather, and it's already starting to darken nicely where it gets handled. These feel like something I'll still have in ten years.
reviews.author: Corvin

reviews.title: Comfortable for long sessions
reviews.body: The extra width over the wrist cuffs makes a real difference. No pinching, no pressure points, and they stay put instead of sliding down. Matched set with the wrist cuffs and the finish is identical.
reviews.author: Wren T.

reviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
reviews.body: Ordered these after the wrist cuffs and the quality is consistent. The hand stitching is genuinely hand stitching, you can see the saddle stitch pattern. Very happy.
reviews.author: Silas M.

reviews.title: Stunning piece
reviews.body: The adjustment range is generous and it sits well without gapping at the front. Plush enough to wear all evening and it looks far more expensive than it was. I get compliments on it constantly.
reviews.author: Ilse V.

reviews.title: Lovely, took some breaking in
reviews.body: The leather was fairly stiff for the first week or two, which I expected from full-grain, and it has softened up beautifully since. Give it time before you judge the fit.
reviews.author: Theo L.
